records.editPrompt: Edit this original transparent 2x2 celestial props tileset. Preserve the four designs, materials, color, richly painted sculptural look and exact quadrant assignments. The upper wing tips and harp ornament touch and are cut off at the canvas top; reconstruct their complete tips. Scale each individual complete object DOWN so its entire silhouette including every feather, ornament, halo, glow and pedestal fits inside the central 80 percent of its own quadrant, with at least 35px fully transparent safety space on ALL four sides of EACH quadrant. Four objects remain separate, evenly spaced in 2x2 grid, no overlapping quadrants. Output transparent alpha square canvas, no opaque background, text, captions or border. Do not invent extra objects.

toolChoice: RPG Mote Studio was initially inaccessible through the web-open tool. A direct Chromium check subsequently loaded the app successfully and showed its 48x48 pencil/layers/timeline pixel-editing workflow. This task needs original painterly complete large scenery props, so built-in image_gen was selected as more suitable for generating them. No third-party images were supplied.
